# shadcn-nsh

Styled NSH component library (copy-into-app), analogous to shadcn/ui on Radix.

## Commands

- Create monorepo: `shadcn-nsh create <name>` → apps/web + packages/ui
- Init existing app: `shadcn-nsh init`
- Add component: `shadcn-nsh add <name>` (monorepo: `-c apps/web` writes packages/ui)
- Registry URL template: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aningdev/shadcn-nsh/main/public/r/{name}.json`

## Layout

- Authoring: packages/theme, packages/ui, packages/cli
- Gallery (native): apps/gallery
- Docs (web): apps/docs
- Consumer template: templates/nsh-monorepo

## Docs

- /docs/getting-started
- /docs/components/button

Theme source of truth is theme.json (nsh.json `theme`), not CSS.
